name: 02571 · Wareham, MA
findings: ZIP 02571 (Wareham) has 32 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (42% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02571 (Wareham) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 6 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 22% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do social and fraternal organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 02571 (Wareham) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 75% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 22% of all organizations here have no identified type.
